verdict.what: a small modern cafe or kiosk with a flat overhanging roof
verdict.style: modern minimal, black and dark wood on a stone plinth
verdict.summary: A tidy little cafe with a nice stone plinth, hedges, lanterns and a wood-banded eave, but the walls are one big black slab (the back is blank) and the roof reads as a lid floating on top, so it needs relief and a more varied facade before it's ready to place.
